---
title: "Naive Bayes Model"
format:
  html:
    code-fold: true
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(e1071)
source("evaluation_functions.R")
live <- load_model_data()
table(live$meta$role)
```

```{r}
nb_fit <- function(x, y, w) {
  keep <- apply(x, 2, sd) > 0
  list(model = naiveBayes(x[, keep, drop = FALSE], y), keep = keep)
}

nb_predict <- function(model, x) {
  as.numeric(predict(model$model, x[, model$keep, drop = FALSE], type = "raw")[, "win"])
}
```

```{r}
cv_nb_skills <- cv_predictions(live, live$x_skills, nb_fit, nb_predict) |>
  mutate(model = "naive_bayes", feature_set = "score_skills")

cv_nb_score <- cv_predictions(live, live$x_score, nb_fit, nb_predict) |>
  mutate(model = "naive_bayes", feature_set = "score")

summary(cv_nb_skills$win_probability)
```

```{r}
cv_other <- read_predictions() |>
  filter(split == "cv", model != "naive_bayes")

scores <- score_predictions(bind_rows(cv_other, cv_nb_skills, cv_nb_score), live$meta)
scores$summary
```

```{r}
scores$by_stage |> filter(model == "naive_bayes")
```

```{r}
scores$calibration |> filter(model == "naive_bayes", feature_set == "score_skills")
```

```{r}
cv_nb_skills |>
  summarise(
    below_5_percent = mean(win_probability < 0.05),
    above_95_percent = mean(win_probability > 0.95)
  )
```

```{r}
example <- cv_nb_skills |>
  inner_join(live$meta, by = c("match_id", "set_number", "point_id")) |>
  filter(match_id == match_id[1], set_number == set_number[1])

ggplot(example, aes(x = rally_number, y = win_probability)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(x = "Completed rallies",
       y = "Probability CU wins the set",
       title = "Naive Bayes predictions during a validation set") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
scores$summary |>
  select(model, feature_set, brier, diff_vs_ref, diff_low, diff_high)
```
